lastAssistantText:
All verifications pass:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| File size | 674 lines, ~25 KB ✓ |

**Built:** `index.html` — a single self-contained Breakout game with level editor:

- **Play mode**: Ball physics, paddle movement (← → arrow keys or mouse/touch), brick collision with axis resolution, score tracking (+10/brick), 3 lives, launch on click/space, win condition detection
- **Editor mode**: Grid overlay with cell snapping, click-drag to place bricks, right-click to erase, 8 color swatches (7 colors + eraser), live preview cursor, grid dimensions display
- **Save/Load**: Modal dialogs — Save copies level JSON to clipboard; Load accepts pasted JSON and applies it to the grid. Auto-saves last edited level to `localStorage`
- **Keyboard shortcuts**: Space/click launch, R restart, 1–7 palette selection, P toggles play/editor
- **Touch support**: touchmove for paddle and brick placement
limitations: No independent browser/visual testing; earlier browser-origin denial honored. VM/DOM/canvas shims do not establish browser compatibility or visual polish.
Single trial per task and configuration; sampling variance prevents strong causal attribution.
